root_causes.description: A deployment spec change killed the checkout container ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted'), and the replacement container in pod checkout-5df89485f4-sjwdb cannot start because the image pull fails with DeadlineExceeded, leaving the pod in ImagePullBackOff / crash-loop back-off. The unavailable replica is the direct cause of the KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch alert and the collapse of checkout traffic (~0.07 req/s).

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted
evidence.observed_value: Container kill event on checkout (count=1) at the start of the incident window
evidence.expected_baseline: No container kill/restart events during steady-state operation

evidence.observed_value: ImagePullBackOff (count=4) with 'Back-off pulling image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest"' (count=4) and 'Failed to pull image ... rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded' (count=2)
evidence.expected_baseline: Image pulls succeed; no ErrImagePull (count=3) or ImagePullBackOff events

evidence.query_or_id: BackOff: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-5df89485f4-sjwdb_otel-demo(f37a0529-b565-4940-bb4f-948166e
evidence.observed_value: Crash-loop back-off restarting the checkout container in pod checkout-5df89485f4-sjwdb
evidence.expected_baseline: Container Running; available replicas == desired replicas

evidence.observed_value: request_rate mean=0.072 req/s, p50=0.076, p95=0.103, max=0.105 req/s during window
evidence.expected_baseline: Normal checkout server request rate of multiple req/s under load-generator traffic

root_causes.description: During the kill/restart cycle, checkout requests stalled: trace search over the window reports p95 duration of 24013ms, while surviving fast traces complete in 9-10ms, indicating requests hanging while the pod was unavailable.

evidence.observed_value: 5 traces total, 0 with errors, p95_duration=24013ms; sample traces c4b53887b8d706aa (9ms), 4096b5a9989b3b0d (10ms), 87c01a37132e72ae (10ms)
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout p95 latency well under 1s (fast traces observed at 9-10ms)

root_causes.description: Upstream blast radius: frontend, which depends on checkout, shows an elevated error rate (max 0.063) during the window as its checkout dependency becomes unavailable due to the ImagePullBackOff crash-loop.

evidence.observed_value: frontend error_rate mean=0.013, p50=0.000, p95=0.050, max=0.063 during window

remediation_steps: Roll back the checkout Deployment to the previous working container definition — the kill event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' shows a recent spec change triggered the outage.

Fix the image pull failure: the pull of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails with DeadlineExceeded — verify registry connectivity/DNS, use an accessible mirror or pre-pulled image, or set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent.
Delete the stuck pod checkout-5df89485f4-sjwdb (in ImagePullBackOff) once the image issue is resolved so the ReplicaSet creates a healthy replacement and replicas match desired state.
Verify recovery: confirm deployment replicas match, checkout request rate returns to baseline, and frontend error_rate returns to ~0.
Add alerting on ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff events and gate rollout on image pull pre-checks to catch this failure mode earlier.
